meta.title: Coaxial cable: fields, capacitance and impedance
meta.tools: 2-D finite-difference Laplace solver (eelab.laplace), energy method, analytic coax formulas
meta.summary: Solve the electrostatic field of RG-58 and RG-6 geometries on a square grid, extract capacitance per metre from the stored energy and compare Z₀ with (60/√ε_r)·ln(b/a); plot E and the (TEM) B-field lines.
meta.problem: Why is coaxial cable 50 or 75 Ω? Derive the impedance from the geometry and confirm it with a field solver.
meta.method:
Square grid (Δ = b/60), inner conductor at 1 V, outer at 0 V (staircase circles). C′ = 2W/V² from the field energy. Two grid sizes
show the staircasing error trend.
